claim: FULL_MUSHROOM is picture code 7F — the whole-mushroom stamp MUSHER loads into Y before writing a cell.
MUSHER is a no-op when a mushroom is already present: it ANDs the cell with 7F and branches past the add if non-zero.

source.verbatim: BNE 20$			;DON'T INCREMENT IF MUSHROOM ALREADY ON SCREEN

claim: MUSHER refuses the top playfield row (row 1F) — a mushroom is never planted on the top row.

source.verbatim: BEQ 20$			;DON'T PUT UP MUSHROOM IF ON TOP ROW

claim: MUSHER refuses the player's own row (row 01, upright) — no mushroom is planted on the player row.

source.verbatim: BEQ 20$			;NOT ON THE SAME ROW AS THE PLAYER

claim: MUSHER increments the row-band mushroom count (INC X,MUSH) once the cell qualifies for the add.
MUSHDC masks the playfield address down to its row (AND 1F) before choosing which count band to adjust.
MUSHDC skips the decrement for the middle band [0C,14): it branches straight to the RTS with no DEC.
MUSHDC decrements the row-band mushroom count (DEC X,MUSH) — the count correction GROWDIE invokes at total death.
RESTOR is frame-gated: it runs only when FRAME AND 03 is zero — every 4th frame (the ';EVERY 16 FRAMES' comment is the ROM author's; the mask is 03).
RESTOR waits for the player explosion to finish (PEXPLD non-zero aborts the pass).

source.verbatim: BNE 5$			;WAIT FOR PLAYER EXPLOSION TO FINISH

claim: RESTOR waits for mushroom growth/death to finish (CDONE non-zero aborts the pass).

source.verbatim: BNE 5$			;WAIT FOR GROWTH/DEATH OF MUSHROOMS TO FINISH

claim: RESTOR restores a damaged mushroom to FULL, preserving the grey-background bit (AND 80 / ORA 7F / STA).
